why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Check that you're allowed. Vana's terms ask you to confirm "You are at least eighteen (18) years of age" and exclude US citizens and residents, as well as anyone in a sanctioned country.
Open community.vana.org and choose "Log in or join". Sign-in runs through account.vana.org, Vana's account service, and asks for your email and linked accounts.
Do the tasks listed in Discord and inside the members area: Discord tasks, Vana events and apps built on Vana. Read what an app asks to see before you allow it.
Spend your XP on the rewards shown in the members area. Vana hasn't said publicly whether XP on a losing bid comes back, so check the rules there before you bid.
costs: The Community Program costs nothing on any public page we read: no fee, no deposit and no wallet are mentioned. The real cost is your data. Connecting a health ring, Instagram or notes lets the apps you approve read them. You can revoke a permission, but data an app has already read has left your hands. Staking VANA at stake.vana.org is a separate thing and not part of the XP program. It needs VAN
risks: Excluded: the terms say "You are not (a) a United States citizen; (b) a United States residents;" and also bar anyone in a country under US, UK, EU or UN sanctions, with Cuba, North Korea, Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Iran and Syria named. Age: 18 or older. KYC: none is described, but the terms say "We may require you to provide information and/or documentation to verify or confirm your eligibility".
